common.transport: USB ADB TCP, one decoder worker

limitations: Short stationary chart screens; not sustained gameplay, continuous pose/content proof, lens quality acceptance or optical latency.
Fresh FPS uses unique GraphStatistics target timestamps, not independently photographed frames. p1 is reciprocal p99 target gap, not an optical result.
All latency values are ALVR estimates. Native fence_ms is CPU record-to-completion; stage timings are separate.
Synchronous GL completion retained. Independent async eye-completion observer is off, so its sample count is zero. Completed/direct-copy counters and eye GPU timer are separate evidence.
Thermals and GPU clocks are sparse; battery temperature is not silicon temperature.
Foveation profiles run sequentially during warm-up; short differences are not causal sustained gains.
Filter comparison uses identical explicit source size and chart but is not a native-vs-supersampled normalized-chart quality experiment.

excluded.reason: Owner interacted with headset/controllers, changing overlay modes; one endpoint capture was blank. Clean repeats replace these cells.
Saved Android refresh override kept actual cadence at 120. Corrected temporary override produced separate valid 207 result.
